## Compatibility and security checklist

- [ ] I worked from the current repository state.
- [ ] I preserved the six canonical Babycowans ecosystem identities.
- [ ] I preserved applicable SPL Token and Token-2022 compatibility boundaries.
- [ ] I preserved applicable protocol, PDA, authority, account, event, and SDK contracts, or clearly documented an intentional compatible change.
- [ ] I did not duplicate low-level protocol logic in higher-level SDK abstractions.
- [ ] I kept the change focused and excluded unrelated refactors.
- [ ] I added or updated relevant tests/evidence where behavior changed.
- [ ] I did not include private keys, seed phrases, credentials, or other secrets.
- [ ] This pull request does not publicly disclose an unremediated security vulnerability.

For suspected security vulnerabilities, stop and use the private reporting process in `SECURITY.md`.
